apps.localizedDescription:
Apollo-Reborn is the community-maintained Apollo sideload build powered by the Apollo-Reborn tweak.

It restores custom API support, media fixes, uploads, inline media, translation, saved categories, Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets, Liquid Glass support on iOS 26+, and the rest of the project’s ongoing fixes and enhancements.

These sources are intended for AltStore Classic, SideStore, and Feather. Apollo-Reborn is not compatible with AltStore PAL.

Choose the source variant that matches how you sideload:

• Standard: full app bundle with Apollo’s working extensions plus Apollo-Reborn widgets
• No Extensions: strips app extensions, including widgets, to reduce App ID usage on free Apple IDs
• GLASS: adds the Liquid Glass iOS 26 patch and bundled Liquid Glass icon catalog
• No Extensions + GLASS: combines both options

The extension-bearing builds (Standard and GLASS) register about 7 App IDs, one per bundled app extension. A free Apple ID can register 10 App IDs per 7 days, so a clean single install fits, but it is easy to exceed if you install under more than one bundle ID, reinstall within the same week, or sideload other extension-bearing apps. If an install fails with an App ID error, use a No Extensions build (1 App ID) or wait for older App IDs to expire. A paid Apple Developer account has a much higher cap.

This project is not affiliated with Apollo or Christian Selig.

versions.localizedDescription:
Liquid Glass build.

Features
- Add iPad Layout (Beta) for iPadOS 18 and later (Settings > Apollo Reborn > Interface > Display & Navigation, off by default): a sidebar with your tabs and favorites, a resizable feed column beside the post you're reading, full-width Gallery View, and menu commands for a hardware keyboard. Apollo offers it once after updating, with Try Now or Try Later, and switching it needs a restart (#1385 (https://github.com/Apollo-Reborn/Apollo-Reborn/pull/1385): @jordanearle)
- Add a Setup Assistant that new installs see first: sign in or restore a backup, pick Classic, Balanced or Full Featured, choose an appearance, and review it all before finishing; reopen it any time from Settings > Apollo Reborn > Setup Assistant (#1401 (https://github.com/Apollo-Reborn/Apollo-Reborn/pull/1401): @jordanearle)
- Bring back the last feed, the open post and roughly where you were reading when iOS closed Apollo in the background (Restore Reading Session, Settings > Apollo Reborn > Media > Browsing, on by default). The saved session expires after seven days and holds no account names or post content (#1441 (https://github.com/Apollo-Reborn/Apollo-Reborn/pull/1441): @Thetromboneman1)
- Open Gallery View faster and resize its tiles by pinching instead of the − and + buttons, now down to four columns; press and hold on a tile or in the fullscreen viewer opens the same menu as feed media, and closing a fullscreen image no longer flashes a black screen (#1434 (https://github.com/Apollo-Reborn/Apollo-Reborn/pull/1434): @IllIIllIllIllII)
- Add Gallery View to Saved, for all saved posts or a single saved category (#1440 (https://github.com/Apollo-Reborn/Apollo-Reborn/pull/1440): @IllIIllIllIllII)
- Show Recently Read as a regular Apollo feed that follows your post size, thumbnail, theme and swipe settings. It moves to its own row on your profile under Hidden & Deleted, its ••• menu has Compact Posts / Large Thumbnails and Clear Read History, and a post's ••• menu gains Remove from Recently Read; the separate Recently Read Thumbnails setting is gone (#1442 (https://github.com/Apollo-Reborn/Apollo-Reborn/pull/1442): @IllIIllIllIllII)

Fixes
- Keep usernames whole in comment headers and the post header above the comments; a long user flair is now cut short first, and the username only shortens when the flair alone doesn't make room (#1366 (https://github.com/Apollo-Reborn/Apollo-Reborn/pull/1366): @AcornElf)
- Fix press and hold on an image, GIF or video inside a post showing the old link menu; it now opens the media menu with copy, save and share, like in the feed (#1435 (https://github.com/Apollo-Reborn/Apollo-Reborn/pull/1435): @IllIIllIllIllII)
- Fix a single photo in a comment failing to upload with Unbox.UnboxError when photos go to Reddit, and multi-photo comments sometimes posting a dead Imgur link instead of the album (#1402 (https://github.com/Apollo-Reborn/Apollo-Reborn/pull/1402): @jordanearle)
- Fix the search bar coming back on Liquid Glass feeds after swiping it away and then closing a fullscreen image (#1447 (https://github.com/Apollo-Reborn/Apollo-Reborn/pull/1447): @Thetromboneman1)
- Fix a crash while loading comments with Show Deleted Comments on (#1450 (https://github.com/Apollo-Reborn/Apollo-Reborn/pull/1450): @Thetromboneman1)
- Fix a crash in Gallery View's image viewer on iOS 14 (#90: @paradoxally)

Liquid Glass build.

Features
- Play sports clips in Gallery View — streamin, streamff, dubz and Streamable tiles, which Reddit gives no preview video, now play muted in the grid like v.redd.it ones, every video tile on screen starts, and opening a clip afterwards plays it straight away (Settings > Apollo Reborn > Media > Browsing > Play Videos in Gallery View) (#1389 (https://github.com/Apollo-Reborn/Apollo-Reborn/pull/1389): @icpryde)
- Lean the Daily Spotlight in the icon picker toward holiday icons around Halloween, Christmas, Pride Month and other holidays; from October 25 to 31 all five picks are Halloween icons, and the header names the holiday (#1390 (https://github.com/Apollo-Reborn/Apollo-Reborn/pull/1390): @icpryde)
- Check for updates every 15 minutes while Apollo is open instead of once a day, so a new release shows up soon after it's published; Later now quiets that version for 24 hours, even across restarts, and a failed check retries after 5 minutes (#1436 (https://github.com/Apollo-Reborn/Apollo-Reborn/pull/1436): @IllIIllIllIllII)

Fixes
- Fix a feed sitting on a spinner forever after Hide Read hides every loaded post; it now loads the next page (#1412 (https://github.com/Apollo-Reborn/Apollo-Reborn/pull/1412): @icpryde)
- Fix API-Key-Free feeds stopping for good after a few pages when Reddit refuses a page with a rate limit or a block page; Apollo shows "Loading next page failed" and asks for the same page again on the next scroll (#1424 (https://github.com/Apollo-Reborn/Apollo-Reborn/pull/1424): @icpryde)
- Fix a post's mute button working backwards after opening a feed video that was playing with sound, with Unmute Videos in Feed on (#1425 (https://github.com/Apollo-Reborn/Apollo-Reborn/pull/1425): @icpryde)
- Fix a crash in feed videos with Unmute Videos in Feed on (#1428 (https://github.com/Apollo-Reborn/Apollo-Reborn/pull/1428): @Thetromboneman1)
- Fix the Liquid Glass tab bar coming back without its glass after swiping back from Edit Profile, leaving the icons floating over the page (#1431 (https://github.com/Apollo-Reborn/Apollo-Reborn/pull/1431): @icpryde)

Liquid Glass build.

Features
- Add a Subreddit Icon switch to Settings > Apollo Reborn > Subreddits > Subreddit Layout (on by default) to hide the community icon in Compact and Immersive headers; the name, subtitle and description move up into its space (#1426 (https://github.com/Apollo-Reborn/Apollo-Reborn/pull/1426): @IllIIllIllIllII)

Liquid Glass build.

Features
- Add Recently Visited to the Search tab, listing the subreddits you've opened, newest first; reorder it alongside Trending Subreddits and Random Subreddit in Settings > Apollo Reborn > Subreddits > Search Tab, and set how many subreddits Trending and Recently Visited show under Section Limits. The list is kept in memory only and clears on restart or account change (#1404 (https://github.com/Apollo-Reborn/Apollo-Reborn/pull/1404): @IllIIllIllIllII)
- Add Add Downvote Tap (Settings > Apollo Reborn > Posts & Feeds > Info Row, off by default) so tapping a post or comment score goes from upvote to downvote before clearing the vote (#1403 (https://github.com/Apollo-Reborn/Apollo-Reborn/pull/1403): @AcornElf)
- Tint the usernames of Apollo Reborn maintainers purple in posts, comments and the inbox, the same way Apollo marks its own developer (#1411 (https://github.com/Apollo-Reborn/Apollo-Reborn/pull/1411): @IllIIllIllIllII)

Fixes
- Fix Apollo crashing when opening an album from its press-and-hold preview in the compact layout (#1398 (https://github.com/Apollo-Reborn/Apollo-Reborn/pull/1398): @IllIIllIllIllII)
- Fix Poll in a subreddit's menu opening the post composer without any poll options; Poll, Media, Link and Text now open straight to their editor, and Poll has a new checklist icon (#1414 (https://github.com/Apollo-Reborn/Apollo-Reborn/pull/1414): @IllIIllIllIllII)
- Fix Reddit image uploads being posted as a broken link when Imgur was still the selected upload host, and hide the long upload URL that pushed the flair out of place on posts that already failed (#1406 (https://github.com/Apollo-Reborn/Apollo-Reborn/pull/1406): @IllIIllIllIllII)
- Fix the Notifications settings screen loading forever on push-capable installs with no notification backend; it now explains what's missing and points to Settings > Apollo Reborn > Advanced > Notification Backend (#1399 (https://github.com/Apollo-Reborn/Apollo-Reborn/pull/1399): @IllIIllIllIllII)
- Fix inline images and GIFs in comments fading to black before opening fullscreen; their press-and-hold menu is now Copy Image, Save Image and Share (#1400 (https://github.com/Apollo-Reborn/Apollo-Reborn/pull/1400): @IllIIllIllIllII)
- Fix outdated subreddit icons and banners, such as r/apple's; saved subreddit list icons are checked for updates weekly and change on the next launch (#1396 (https://github.com/Apollo-Reborn/Apollo-Reborn/pull/1396): @IllIIllIllIllII)
- Fix the separator below Home's first post disappearing after switching tabs and pulling to refresh (#1405 (https://github.com/Apollo-Reborn/Apollo-Reborn/pull/1405): @IllIIllIllIllII)
- Fix Reddit links in a user's Social Links opening in the browser instead of in Apollo (#1407 (https://github.com/Apollo-Reborn/Apollo-Reborn/pull/1407): @IllIIllIllIllII)
- Fix the Boxes title shortening to "Box…" after swiping back from an inbox on Liquid Glass (#1395 (https://github.com/Apollo-Reborn/Apollo-Reborn/pull/1395): @IllIIllIllIllII)
- Fix the Portrait Lock settings page using full-width sections instead of the rounded style of the rest of Settings (#1410 (https://github.com/Apollo-Reborn/Apollo-Reborn/pull/1410): @IllIIllIllIllII)

Liquid Glass build.

Fixes
- Fix lists sticking at the top for a moment when a fast flick to the top is reversed — the bounce animation kept pulling the list back while the finger dragged it down, and it now stops the moment a drag begins, in feeds, comments and other standard lists on iOS 17.4 and later. On an iPhone 16 Pro the stall showed up in 9 of 10 reversals before and 0 of 20 after (#85: @paradoxally)

Liquid Glass build.

Performance

Feeds now scroll smoother, most of all deep into a feed and with keyword filters on. Every number below was measured on an iPhone 16 Pro before and after the change.
- Improve scrolling — keychain reads and text-pattern building no longer run while a feed scrolls, cutting stutters (frames over 25 ms) from 5 to 2.5 per 32-second scroll and the time lost to late frames from 166 ms to 62 ms (#80: @paradoxally)
- Improve loading more posts — each new page rebuilds the post list 3 times instead of 5, and each skipped rebuild saves 9.5 ms at page 10 and 13.5 ms at page 20, so long stalls (over 50 ms) on a deep scroll drop from 10 to 6 (#81: @paradoxally)
- Improve keyword filters — checking every loaded post against the Filters & Blocks keywords takes 30 ms instead of up to 398 ms per deep scroll, and with 7 keywords set the stalls over 50 ms go from 1.3 to 0; feeds without keywords are unaffected (#82: @paradoxally)
- Use less memory for very large images in Gallery View, Image Chest albums and Chat, which now load at the size they're shown instead of at full resolution (#1320 (https://github.com/Apollo-Reborn/Apollo-Reborn/pull/1320): @ryannair05)

Features
- Add an in-app update prompt — Apollo Reborn checks for a new release once a day and hands it to AltStore, SideStore, Feather or FlareStore, or downloads the IPA, with the release notes a tap away; Check for Updates is in Settings > Apollo Reborn > About and Automatic Update Checks in Privacy (#1343 (https://github.com/Apollo-Reborn/Apollo-Reborn/pull/1343): @IllIIllIllIllII, #77, #79: @paradoxally)
- Add a Liquid Glass switch (Settings > Apollo Reborn > Interface > Appearance, on by default) so Liquid Glass builds can use Apollo's classic look without installing a different IPA; Apollo asks to quit and reopen for it to apply (#1384 (https://github.com/Apollo-Reborn/Apollo-Reborn/pull/1384): @IllIIllIllIllII)
- Add a Minimize Hide Style to Hide Bars on Scroll (Settings > Apollo Reborn > Interface > Tab Bar, Liquid Glass) that shrinks the tab bar into a small glass pill showing the current tab, like Safari, and bring hidden bars back when a page opens or you go back (#1349 (https://github.com/Apollo-Reborn/Apollo-Reborn/pull/1349), #1384 (https://github.com/Apollo-Reborn/Apollo-Reborn/pull/1384): @IllIIllIllIllII)
- Add Reduce Rate Limiting (Settings > Apollo Reborn > Accounts & API Keys > Experimental, off by default) so API-Key-Free accounts hit Reddit's request limit less often — profile pictures load in batches, Community Highlights refresh every 30 minutes instead of every 2, and sign-ins are checked less often; even with it off, these accounts send fewer requests at launch (#1369 (https://github.com/Apollo-Reborn/Apollo-Reborn/pull/1369): @icpryde)
- Write Apollo AI summaries in a chosen Language (Settings > Apollo Reborn > Apollo AI > Summaries, Device Default by default), on device and with every cloud provider including OpenAI; when a cloud summary fails, Apple Intelligence writes it in a language it supports, and the next visit tries the cloud again (#1362 (https://github.com/Apollo-Reborn/Apollo-Reborn/pull/1362): @icpryde, #83: @paradoxally)
- Open Edit Profile (a profile's ••• menu) inside Apollo on iOS 16 and later, signed in as the current account and themed, instead of in Safari (#1367 (https://github.com/Apollo-Reborn/Apollo-Reborn/pull/1367): @icpryde)
- Add a User Profiles settings page (Settings > Apollo Reborn > User Profiles) that brings Profile Layout, Show User Profile Pictures and Profile Picture Shape together, with a live sample comment (#1352 (https://github.com/Apollo-Reborn/Apollo-Reborn/pull/1352): @IllIIllIllIllII)
- Reorganize Subreddits settings into Subreddit List, Subreddit Appearance and Search Tab Sources, and redesign Subreddit List Sections with a preview that looks like the real subreddit list (#1350 (https://github.com/Apollo-Reborn/Apollo-Reborn/pull/1350), #1351 (https://github.com/Apollo-Reborn/Apollo-Reborn/pull/1351): @IllIIllIllIllII)
- Rework Customize Action Menus (Settings > Apollo Reborn > Interface) with clearer descriptions, an All Menus view showing where each action is hidden, and a Reset Menu… that can reset just the order; Remind Me In… is back in the ••• menus on Liquid Glass (#1323 (https://github.com/Apollo-Reborn/Apollo-Reborn/pull/1323): @AcornElf, #1368 (https://github.com/Apollo-Reborn/Apollo-Reborn/pull/1368): @icpryde)
- Add Settings Icon Theme (Settings > Appearance > Other) to show settings icons as colored symbols on dark tiles, always or only in dark mode; the duplicate Apollo Ultra row moves to About (#1377 (https://github.com/Apollo-Reborn/Apollo-Reborn/pull/1377): @IllIIllIllIllII)
- Press and hold the Posts tab to open the subreddit switcher while a feed is open, now on Liquid Glass too (#1387 (https://github.com/Apollo-Reborn/Apollo-Reborn/pull/1387): @IllIIllIllIllII)
- Add tile size buttons to Gallery View to switch between four tile sizes, from a denser grid to a single column (#1357 (https://github.com/Apollo-Reborn/Apollo-Reborn/pull/1357): @jordanearle)
- Add Witching Hour and Count Helios, two Halloween icons, to the Helios icon pack, and give this release's What's New a one-time Halloween look (#1378 (https://github.com/Apollo-Reborn/Apollo-Reborn/pull/1378): @IllIIllIllIllII, #1386 (https://github.com/Apollo-Reborn/Apollo-Reborn/pull/1386): @icpryde, #84: @paradoxally)

Fixes
- Fix crashes when adding or removing a favorite on the Subreddits list, while writing a Media post, and when swiping between pages of the fullscreen media viewer (#1336 (https://github.com/Apollo-Reborn/Apollo-Reborn/pull/1336): @icpryde)
- Fix Apollo crashing when switching accounts with the Inbox open (#1379 (https://github.com/Apollo-Reborn/Apollo-Reborn/pull/1379): @icpryde)
- Fix very long text posts showing a blank body at the largest text sizes (#1381 (https://github.com/Apollo-Reborn/Apollo-Reborn/pull/1381): @icpryde)
- Fix Continue with Google doing nothing and Continue with Apple showing an error on Reddit's sign-in page; both now open in a sheet (#1372 (https://github.com/Apollo-Reborn/Apollo-Reborn/pull/1372): @icpryde)
- Stop the pause between Liquid Glass menus when reporting, setting post flair or removing a post as a moderator (#1382 (https://github.com/Apollo-Reborn/Apollo-Reborn/pull/1382): @icpryde)
- Fix swiping from the left edge still going back with Disable Navigation Gestures on, and stop a right swipe over a comment on Liquid Glass leaving the thread instead of running the comment's swipe action (#1370 (https://github.com/Apollo-Reborn/Apollo-Reborn/pull/1370): @icpryde)
- Stop YouTube videos on iOS 27 playing with captions that can't be turned off (#1371 (https://github.com/Apollo-Reborn/Apollo-Reborn/pull/1371): @icpryde)
- Stop the search bar under the header flashing as a feed or post opens with Header Style set to Hard (#1373 (https://github.com/Apollo-Reborn/Apollo-Reborn/pull/1373): @icpryde)
- Show a message instead of an endless spinner when a profile's Comments or Posts come back empty (#1341 (https://github.com/Apollo-Reborn/Apollo-Reborn/pull/1341): @icpryde)
- Hide profile stats entirely when Stat Cards is off (#1348 (https://github.com/Apollo-Reborn/Apollo-Reborn/pull/1348): @IllIIllIllIllII)
- Show every post's subreddit icon in Home, Popular, All and multireddits, not just the first per subreddit (#1363 (https://github.com/Apollo-Reborn/Apollo-Reborn/pull/1363): @icpryde)
- Fix tapping the Posts tab sometimes stopping short of the top of a long feed; it now goes all the way up like a status-bar tap (#1360 (https://github.com/Apollo-Reborn/Apollo-Reborn/pull/1360): @IllIIllIllIllII)
- Load more replies smoothly — the spinner stays until the replies fade in, and in a translated thread they arrive already translated (#1358 (https://github.com/Apollo-Reborn/Apollo-Reborn/pull/1358): @icpryde)
- Fix translation labels naming the wrong language or appearing on text that wasn't translated (#1380 (https://github.com/Apollo-Reborn/Apollo-Reborn/pull/1380): @icpryde)
- Stop a comment's rich link card image flashing on every vote (#1356 (https://github.com/Apollo-Reborn/Apollo-Reborn/pull/1356): @icpryde)
- Say why a RedGIFs post couldn't load — removed, not found, not available in the region, or unreachable — instead of "RedGIFs error :(" (#1359 (https://github.com/Apollo-Reborn/Apollo-Reborn/pull/1359): @icpryde)
- Keep Settings Shortcuts section titles in place when adding or removing a shortcut (#1355 (https://github.com/Apollo-Reborn/Apollo-Reborn/pull/1355): @icpryde)
- Fade the background when dragging a fullscreen image or video away sideways or at an angle (#1320 (https://github.com/Apollo-Reborn/Apollo-Reborn/pull/1320): @ryannair05)

Liquid Glass build.

Features
- Add Kagi to the Search tab — tap the magnifier and pick Kagi to search Reddit with your Kagi subscription's Session Link instead of an API key (each page of results counts as one search on your plan); results load as you scroll and open natively with Reddit's score, comment count and age, and the link can be changed or cleared in Settings > Apollo Reborn > Accounts & API Keys > Kagi Search (#1305 (https://github.com/Apollo-Reborn/Apollo-Reborn/pull/1305): @nickclyde)

Fixes
- Keep media previews and your current user flair working for API-Key-Free accounts now that Reddit is limiting Old Reddit to accounts that used it in the last six months — both now load from www.reddit.com, and the flair picker matches your flair by its real template (#1327 (https://github.com/Apollo-Reborn/Apollo-Reborn/pull/1327): @nickclyde)

name: Apollo-Reborn - GLASS
subtitle: Apollo-Reborn source with Liquid Glass patch
description: GLASS Apollo-Reborn source for AltStore Classic, SideStore, and Feather. Includes Apollo-Reborn widgets, the Liquid Glass iOS 26 patch, and bundled Liquid Glass alternate icons. Registers about 7 App IDs, one per bundled extension; on a free Apple ID (limited to 10 App IDs per 7 days) a clean install fits but leaves little headroom, so use the No Extensions + GLASS source if you hit the App ID limit. Not compatible with AltStore PAL.
